title: UE initiated detach procedure completion for EPS services only

entities.name: UE initiated detach procedure completion
entities.description: Procedure for completing UE-initiated detach for EPS services only, involving message exchange and state transitions.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: DETACH ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept detach request, unless Detach type indicates switch off.

entities.name: Detach type
entities.description: IE indicating type of detach, e.g., switch off or not.

entities.name: T3421
entities.description: Timer stopped by UE upon receiving DETACH ACCEPT message.

entities.name: EMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: State entered by network and UE after detach procedure completion.

entities.name: EMM-NULL
entities.description: State entered by UE if detach was due to disabling of EPS services.

entities.name: Detach type not switch off
entities.description: Condition where Detach type IE does not indicate switch off.

entities.name: Detach due to disabling EPS services
entities.description: Condition where detach procedure was performed due to disabling of EPS services.

entities.name: Deactivate EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Network and UE deactivate EPS bearer contexts locally without peer-to-peer signalling.

entities.name: Mark UE as inactive for EPS services
entities.description: Network marks UE as inactive for EPS services after detach.

relations.description: Procedure involves receiving DETACH REQUEST message.
Procedure involves sending DETACH ACCEPT message if Detach type not switch off.
DETACH REQUEST message contains Detach type IE.
Sending DETACH ACCEPT is guarded by Detach type not indicating switch off.
UE stops timer T3421 upon receiving DETACH ACCEPT.
Procedure establishes deactivation of EPS bearer contexts.
Procedure establishes marking UE as inactive for EPS services.
Procedure establishes EMM-DEREGISTERED state in network and UE.
Condition of disabling EPS services establishes EMM-NULL state in UE.
